calculator_engine: function zerodha(buy,sell,qty,type){const turnover=(buy+sell)*qty;let brokerage=type==='Equity Delivery'?0:Math.min((buy*qty+sell*qty)*0.0003/2,20)*2;const stt=type==='Equity Delivery'?(buy+sell)*qty*0.001:sell*qty*0.00025;const exchCharges=turnover*(type.includes('Futures')?0.0002:0.0035)/100;const gst=(brokerage+exchCharges)*0.18;const sebi=turnover*0.0000001;const total=brokerage+stt+exchCharges+gst+sebi;return{brokerage,stt,exchCharges,gst,sebi,total,netPL:(sell-buy)*qty-total};}
